title: Editing or Deleting a SAML Identity Provider

blocks.text: You can edit or delete a SAML identity provider (IdP) as necessary. You can also add a Request Signing and Decryption Certificate for SAML protocol.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Authentication > External Identities.
On the External Identities page, click the Edit icon for the required primary or secondary SAML IdP.
See image.
The Edit External Identity page appears.
On the Edit External Identity page, go to the Advanced Configurations tab.
Edit the information in the Authentication Request, Encrypted SAML Assertion, Request Signing and Decryption Certificate, and Session Attribute Mapping sections.
See image.
Click Save.

blocks.text: A message is displayed indicating the IdP is updated successfully.

blocks.heading: Adding a New Request Signing and Decryption Certificate

blocks.text: To add a new Request Signing and Decryption Certificate:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Authentication > External Identities.
On the External Identities page, click the Edit icon for the required primary or secondary SAML IdP.
See image.
The External Identity page appears.
On the External Identity page, go to the Advanced Configurations tab.
In the Request Signing and Decryption Certificate section, click Add. A new Request Signing and Decryption Certificate is added with two years of validity.
The following items appear for each certificate:
Serial Number: The serial number of the certificate.
Name: The name of the certificate.
Expiration Date: The date when the certificate expires. The following icons appear when the certificate is expiring within 90 days.
Caution icon: Appears when the certificate is about to expire.
Red Exclamation Mark icon: Appears when the certificate is expired.
Download: Click the Download icon to download the certificate. You might need to upload this certificate to the IdP.
Delete: Click the Delete icon to delete the certificate. An active certificate cannot be deleted.
You can have a maximum of two Request Signing and Decryption Certificates at a time, out of which only one can be active.
See image.
Click Save.
Go to Administration > Authentication > External Identities.
On the External Identities page, click the Delete icon for the required primary or secondary SAML IdP.
See image.
Read the confirmation message, enter CONFIRM, then click Delete.
See image.
